metadata.title: Palo Alto Stock: Its Greatest Strength Is Also a Critical Risk<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Palo Alto Networks’ Greatest Strength Is Also a Critical Risk
Palo Alto Networks stock is on track for two days of near 10% gains. The stock’s remarkable performance reflects why it’s so critical to companies amid ubiquitous artificial intelligence market hype—but this very same success could reveal a hidden risk.
